-->

W hen the Pakistan Air Force released a mostly AI-generated video on September 7 depicting its implausible ‘victory’ over India during Operation Sindoor, it grabbed eyeballs and got mocked.

But beneath the fabricated claims lay a genuine defence upgrade.

For the first time, Pakistan showcased its Chinese-origin HQ-17AE short-range surface-to-air missile (SAM) system, and Turkish-made Şahin counter-unmanned aerial vehicle (C-UAV) weapon and Korkut self-propelled anti-aircraft gun (SPAAG).

Show Full Article

This display reinforced the obvious — Islamabad’s deepening defence partnerships with Beijing and Ankara. But it also pointed to something subtler and larger: a pattern of growing defence cooperation between autocratic governments and the role the military-industrial complex plays in entrenching such illiberalism. Nowhere is this trend clearer than in the export story of the JF-17 Thunder fighter jet, which also featured in the PAF video.

Also Read: Asim Munir wants to redraw Pakistan. The first field marshal’s One Unit debacle offers a warning

 

The ‘thunder’ around JF-17
From December 2025 onwards, Reuters began publishing a string of reports, almost like clockwork, about Pakistan signing or negotiating defence deals with several countries. At the heart of these deals was the JF-17 fighter jet. Libya was the first to be reported on. Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, Sudan, Indonesia and Somalia have since reportedly expressed interest in acquiring the aircraft.

The noise around the JF-17 ‘Thunder’ petered out a few months into 2026. But such prospective deals hold pieces of a larger puzzle that could aid understanding of the broader alignment between China, Pakistan and the states operating, or interested in, the aircraft.

Jointly produced by the Pakistan Aeronautical Complex and Chengdu Aircraft Corporation, the JF-17 is powered by Russian-made Klimov engines: RD-93 (used in Block I and Block II variants) and RD-93MA (Block III). With its first prototype taking its maiden flight in 2003 and later being inducted into the Pakistan Air Force in the late 2000s, the JF-17 has been elevated to what can be regarded as a tour de force of the China-Pakistan friendship —  dubbed “higher than the mountains…stronger than steel”.

While the sudden surge in interest from late 2025 did raise eyebrows about the substance of Reuters ’ reports, the JF-17 does appear to be having its moment under the sun. Materialisation of deals notwithstanding, the reports alone amounted to a huge publicity boost. Coupled with the fact that the JF-17 now has the tag of ‘ combat-tested ’ after Pakistan reportedly used the aircraft, alongside the Chinese J-10Cs, during its four-day conflict with India in May 2025. That it was deployed against an air force operating a mix of Western and Russian fighter planes lent further credibility to the aircraft’s prowess.

A tool of influence
What is underexplored about this 4.5-generation, single-engine, all-weather, multi-role aircraft is the profile of its current and speculated export destinations. Beijing appears to be leveraging the JF-17 as a tool to export its influence, specifically among nations that are at odds, to varying degrees, with the largely liberal West.

Libya is a case in point. Pakistan’s deal was signed with the Libyan National Army, whose authority over eastern Libya is not recognised by the United Nations, which only accords legitimacy to the government in charge of the western territory. Add to that, Libya has been subject to an arms embargo since 2011, with arms transfers allowed solely to the internationally recognised government in Tripoli. Similarly, Sudan, a country rendered asunder by the civil war that erupted in 2023, is subject to arms embargoes by the West.

The political trajectories of the three countries that officially operate the JF-17 tell a similar story. Myanmar, Nigeria and Azerbaijan have displayed weakened democratic principles to differing degrees and have increasingly taken an authoritarian turn. Myanmar, the first importer of the JF-17, is sanctioned by the US and some of its allies to boot, while the country itself has been ravaged by a civil war since 2021.

This suggests the Sino-Pakistani nexus is consolidating influence among nations with governance and freedom profiles similar to theirs through inter alia defence partnerships. China’s export of its authoritarianism in digital and political forms is fairly well-documented. Less examined is the role of defence exports. Arms sales to non-democratic, authoritarian or military-dominated states by like-minded regimes account for a subtler yet consequential tool of extending sway. The JF-17’s export pattern fits this description closely.

While Pakistan’s former army chief Qamar Javed Bajwa pivoted from geopolitics to geoeconomics , his successor, Field Marshal Asim Munir, seems to be advancing what can be called a mix of economics and defence.

Pakistan is projecting JF-17 deals as a means of generating revenue for its economy, which has a long-standing history of external bailouts. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif remarked that the country is “receiving so many orders that Pakistan may not need the International Monetary Fund in six months”. Further highlighting this defence-economics nexus is the potential conversion of a Saudi loan into an arms agreement. That the military, not the civilian leadership, is steering such efforts is evident; for example, Field Marshals Asim Munir of Pakistan and Khalifa Haftar of Libya are negotiating the JF-17 deal.

China: The ultimate winner?
A Foreign Affairs essay, ‘ The Illiberal International’ , spotlighted the burgeoning coordination among illiberal governments through military and financial tools, resulting in the entrenchment of illiberal governance.

To illustrate this, the piece cites Turkey’s supply of Bayraktar TB2 drones to Azerbaijan and Libya — both of which have also cut JF-17 deals with Pakistan. One can also reference the Turkey-Pakistan defence partnership in a similar vein. Turkey plans to establish a drone assembly facility in Pakistan. Here, it is worth mentioning that just as Pakistan is maximising the JF-17’s battlefield credentials to buoy up the aircraft’s marketability, Turkey has similarly capitalised on its drone’s performance in the Russia-Ukraine and Armenia-Azerbaijan conflicts to boost its exportability.

A separate Lowy Institute study identifies four ways through which military and security cooperation occurs among illiberal powers: transfer of weapons and war-fighting equipment; provision of non-lethal resources like intelligence and satellite information; structured military exercises; and, more prominently, through formal pacts. China and Pakistan tick all four of these boxes and may extend the same channels of cooperation to countries they want as customers.

The Mecca Joint Defense Agreement between Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, all three of which have illiberal governments, also checks the same four boxes. China stands to gain from this indirectly. As Pakistan becomes more embedded in Gulf security arrangements, Chinese-built systems, training and maintenance networks could gain a  foothold   in the region by extension, given China’s overwhelming influence over Pakistan. There can also be an overlap of defence supply chains and the military-industrial complex of the Mecca Pact countries and China. If collaboration between them deepens, the role of a ‘liberal’ US as a traditional security guarantor in the region will further diminish, paving the way for a Chinese-led ‘illiberal’ architecture.

China, despite co-producing the JF-17, does not itself operate the aircraft. But Beijing is unmistakably the face of such deals and any sale is likely to be regarded as a win for Chinese influence, which China may well be encouraging.

There is reason to believe this. The states operating or planning to negotiate a JF-17 deal are  participants  in China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), already tied to Beijing economically, infrastructurally, and to some extent, through a political slant. It is not implausible that Beijing sees defence cooperation as a way of deepening the extant relationship. Correlation is not causation. But a history of economic cooperation often facilitates future collaboration in other sectors.

Many of these countries are also mired in conflicts, domestic and international, which drives their increased need for arms procurement. In an unstable geopolitical environment, the Sino-Pakistani military-industrial complex stands to benefit from conflict-prone regions, where their platforms can acquire the combat-proven tag, boosting future sales. The more battlefields their platforms are tested in, the better.

And where there is war, there is money to be made, as the saying goes. Africa, convulsed by conflicts that get little attention due to the high-profile wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, is one region worth watching closely on this front. China and Pakistan, and even Turkey, may seek to make Africa their next big market for weapons.

Also read: Saudi firm bets $200 mn on Afghanistan’s energy sector. Can it succeed where Chinese failed?

 

Arms and ideology
The intertwining of ideology and defence exports is not new, but it is often overlooked.

As China throws its weight globally, its growing role in the weapons market, especially among countries classified as illiberal, deserves closer scrutiny from observers and policymakers. Such deals are not purely confined to the defence sphere. They also signal deeper strategic alignment, something defenders of liberal democracies would do well to examine if they want to halt the expansion of illiberal networks.

Part of the appeal is that Beijing, unlike Washington, does not impose political, value-based constraints on defence partnerships. A sense of ease appears to exist between China and countries that have either not reaped the benefits from a democratic system or are seeking to diversify partnerships beyond the West, both of which pave the way for greater trust. Such relations not only entrench China’s influence within these states, but in a way also sustain those illiberal regimes.

For Pakistan, if these deals materialise, its cherished goal of becoming a net security provider in the Arab region and beyond could inch closer to reality, with the already existing Strategic Mutual Defense Agreement (SDMA) with Saudi Arabia and the Mecca Agreement acting as two anchors.

items.title: Traders brace for prolonged India bond slump as RBI mops up excess cash
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Bond traders expect yields to rise as the RBI drains excess liquidity amid higher oil prices, rising inflation and heavy government debt supply ...
items.body: By Subhadip Sircar and Bhaskar Dutta A sense of unease is gripping India’s bond traders as they fear the central bank’s push to drain excess cash from the financial system, just as inflation picks up and a global debt selloff intensifies, will spark an extended slump. ICICI Securities Primary Dealership Ltd., one of the nation’s largest underwriters of government debt, and IDFC First Bank Ltd. are among those predicting the benchmark 10-year yield to potentially surpass the 2026 peak hit in May and climb as high as 7.25% by Dec. 31. That would be the highest level in three years. Citigroup Inc. has brought forward its expectation for an interest-rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India to October from December. It’s a sharp reversal in sentiment. Just last month, the central bank drew a record $127 billion from India’s diaspora through special deposits as it sought to bolster its foreign-exchange reserves and defend the rupee. The inflows, which surpassed even the RBI’s own estimates, pushed the banking system’s cash surplus to an all-time high of about ₹11 trillion ($115 billion), helping cushion local bonds as yields in major markets surged to multiyear highs. But with the liquidity glut and a renewed surge in oil prices intensifying inflation risks, the RBI has sprung into action. Its plan to drain ₹1 trillion from lenders through open-market bond sales sent yields surging across the curve on Tuesday, with the 10-year rate now at 7.08%. Markets are bracing for more such measures in the weeks and months ahead. “The outlook is messy and it’s tough to call a peak for yields,” said Ashhish Vaidya, head of treasury at DBS Bank Ltd. in Mumbai. “The situation has clearly changed, traders are now repositioning for a more challenging supply situation as well as higher inflation.”  The RBI’s move came after the excess cash caused interbank borrowing rates to fall well below its policy benchmark. The easing of financial conditions appeared to be at odds with policymakers’ latest signals that rates may need to rise to contain inflation. For bond traders, the timing is particularly painful. The central bank is emerging as a seller just as government borrowing for the second half of the fiscal year gets underway, adding to an already-heavy supply of debt in the market. “The dictum that too much of a good thing may well be a problematic issue could certainly apply to the situation that India is facing right now,” Michael Wan, senior currency analyst at MUFG Bank Ltd., wrote in a note. “RBI’s most immediate challenge is to deploy its suite of tools to mop up this excess liquidity.” The central bank will need to quickly drain another ₹2 trillion of excess liquidity from the banking system, which could potentially be through short-term foreign-exchange swaps or the issuance of Market Stabilization Scheme securities and cash-management bills, according to QuantEco Research. The RBI didn’t immediately respond to an email seeking comments on its plans. Chandresh Jain, EM Asia rates and FX strategist at BNP Paribas SA, expects bonds with maturities of three to 10 years to come under further selling pressure. Local banks have been holding three- to five-year bonds due to excessive cash, and as the glut eases, yields on those bonds could rise faster than those on 10-year debt, he said.‘Cannot Afford’Data on Monday showed India’s inflation accelerated in August, moving closer to the top of the RBI’s 2%-6% target range and potentially narrowing the scope for it to remain on hold for long. Market watchers now increasingly expect the central bank to raise the benchmark rate by 25 basis points at its policy decision on Oct. 7, adding to the upward pressure on yields. “The next natural step will be to hike the policy rate in the October policy by 25bps, followed by another 25bps rate hike in December,” according to Kaushik Das, chief India economist at Deutsche Bank AG. As markets reacted to the RBI’s announcement of open-market bond sales, the selloff in shorter debt was more pronounced. Yields on five-year notes jumped 21 basis points on Tuesday, the most since May 2022, outpacing a 6-basis-point increase in 10-year yields. Similar-maturity US Treasury yields rose to the highest since 2007 later the same day. Foreign investors cut their holdings of index-eligible Indian bonds by ₹2,470 crore on Tuesday. That followed an outflow of ₹4,730 crore on Friday, which was the biggest since April last year. Indian markets were shut on Monday. “The bond market is bearing the immediate fallout” of the RBI’s aggressive pivot toward outright OMO sales, said Naveen Ramnani, chief dealer of treasury and investment at UCO Bank. “Managing the cash surplus is critical because lingering inflation risks mean loose overnight rates are a luxury the central bank cannot afford.”

items.title: Revolut beantragt Schweizer Banklizenz und plant Millioneninvestition
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die britische Digitalbank Revolut will mit einer eigenen Lizenz und Millioneninvestitionen ihr Geschäft im lukrativen Schweizer Markt ausbauen. Das Unternehmen habe bei der Eidgenössischen Finanzmarktaufsicht (Finma) eine Banklizenz beantragt, teilte Revolut am Mittwoch mit. Mit der Lizenz wolle Revolut den Kunden in der Schweiz ein breiteres Angebot unter anderem mit Gehaltskonten, einem Zugang zur Schweizer Einlagensicherung und lokalen IBAN-Kontonummern anbieten. In dem Land würde Revolut nach Großbritannien, Litauen und Frankreich damit die vierte eigenständige Bank in Europa betreiben, sagte Revolut-Vertriebschef David Tirado der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Das spiegelt die Bedeutung wider, die wir diesem Markt beimessen."
items.body:
Die britische Digitalbank Revolut will mit einer eigenen Lizenz und Millioneninvestitionen ihr Geschäft im lukrativen Schweizer Markt ausbauen. Das Unternehmen habe bei der Eidgenössischen Finanzmarktaufsicht (Finma) eine Banklizenz beantragt, teilte Revolut am Mittwoch mit. Mit der Lizenz wolle Revolut den Kunden in der Schweiz ein breiteres Angebot unter anderem mit Gehaltskonten, einem Zugang zur Schweizer Einlagensicherung und lokalen IBAN-Kontonummern anbieten. In dem Land würde Revolut nach Großbritannien, Litauen und Frankreich damit die vierte eigenständige Bank in Europa betreiben, sagte Revolut-Vertriebschef David Tirado der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Das spiegelt die Bedeutung wider, die wir diesem Markt beimessen."
Eingeschränkt ist das Fintech in der Schweiz bisher dadurch, dass es keine Gehaltskonten und auch keine auf Franken lautenden Anlagekonten anbieten kann. Dennoch ist Revolut mit mehr als 1,3 Millionen Kunden eigenen Angaben zufolge die führende Digitalbank des Landes. Dies entspreche einer Marktdurchdringung von rund 24 Prozent, sagte Tirado. "In zwei bis drei Jahren rechnen wir damit, die Marke von 40 Prozent zu überschreiten."
Gegenwärtig ist Revolut in der Schweiz und in Deutschland über die in Litauen zugelassene Revolut Bank UAB aktiv. Diese wird sowohl von der Bank von Litauen als auch von der Europäischen Zentralbank beaufsichtigt. "Was uns im Wettbewerb mit den etablierten Schweizer Banken gegenwärtig fehlt, ist Vertrauen", erklärte Tirado. "Wir glauben, dass dies das fehlende Puzzleteil ist." Mit einer Regulierung durch die Finma würden auch alle Prozesse von der Behörde validiert. Revolut wolle bei den Kunden zudem mit einer besseren Nutzererfahrung und einem besseren Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis als die Konkurrenz punkten, von Geldanlagen bis hin zum Zahlungsverkehr.
REVOLUT WILL PERSONALBESTAND VERDREIFACHEN In den kommenden fünf Jahren plant der Finanzdienstleister in der Schweiz Investitionen von mehr als 150 Millionen Franken. Der Personalbestand von gegenwärtig rund 30 Mitarbeitern solle bis Ende des kommenden Jahres verdreifacht werden, sagte Schweiz-Chef Julian Biegmann. "Wir werden unser lokales Team deutlich ausbauen und alle Funktionen ansiedeln, die für den Betrieb einer Schweizer Bank erforderlich sind." Heute nutze deutlich mehr als die Hälfte der Kunden in der Schweiz Revolut monatlich. Noch wichtiger als die Steigerung der Kundenzahl sei es, diese dazu zu bringen, Revolut als Alltagsbank zu nutzen. Ein Einstieg ins Vermögensverwaltungsgeschäft sei eines der Themen, die der Konzern gegenwärtig prüfe. In der Schweiz habe dies jedoch keine Priorität.
Der Zulassungsantrag in der Schweiz ist Teil der Expansionsstrategie des Unternehmens. Anfang des Monats erhielt die Neobank eine vorläufige Genehmigung für eine nationale Banklizenz in den USA. Im März sicherte sich Revolut eine Banklizenz in Großbritannien, im August folgte die Zulassung in [USN:L8N4470JG TEXT:"Frankreich"]. Revolut hat weltweit rund 80 Millionen Kunden. Tirado zufolge befinde sich das Unternehmen in einer Aktien-Platzierungsrunde, in der Mitarbeiter Anteile an neue Investoren verkauften. Der Preis entspreche dabei einer Gesamtbewertung des Unternehmens von 150 Milliarden Dollar. "Dies macht uns zum größten privaten Technologieunternehmen in Europa."

items.title: Revolut applies for Swiss banking licence, unveils investment plans
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British digital bank Revolut has applied for a Swiss banking licence and unveiled plans to invest more than 150 million Swiss francs ($183 million) to expand in the lucrative Swiss market.
items.body:
British digital bank Revolut has applied for a Swiss banking licence and unveiled plans to invest more than 150 million Swiss francs ($183 million) to expand in the lucrative Swiss market.
The company has applied for a licence with the Financial Market Supervisory Authority (Finma), Revolut said on Wednesday.
Approval would allow Revolut to offer customers in Switzerland a broader range of services, including salary accounts, access to Swiss deposit insurance, and local IBAN account numbers.
It would make Revolut's Swiss business the fourth standalone bank it operates in Europe, after Britain, Lithuania, and France, said Chief Commercial Officer David Tirado.
"This reflects the importance we give to this market," he told Reuters.
Until now, the fintech has been limited in Switzerland by the fact that it cannot offer salary accounts or investment accounts denominated in francs.
"In Switzerland, we have 1.3 million customers, which corresponds to a penetration of around 24%," said Tirado. "In two to three years, we would expect to surpass 40%."
The application is part of the company's expansion strategy.
Earlier this [USN:L4N44V1DD TEXT:"month"], Revolut received preliminary approval for a national banking licence in the United States. It secured banking licences in Britain and France earlier this year.
Currently, Revolut operates in Switzerland and Germany through Revolut Bank UAB, which is licensed in Lithuania.
"What we are currently missing to compete with incumbent Swiss banks is trust," said Tirado. "We think this is the missing piece of the puzzle."
Over the next five years, Revolut also plans to invest more than 150 million francs in Switzerland.
The workforce, currently around 30 employees, will be tripled by the end of next year, said Switzerland general manager Julian Biegmann.
"We'll build out our local team significantly, all the functions you need to have in order to operate as a Swiss bank," he said.
($1 = 0.8183 Swiss francs)

items.title: Von der Leyen pedirá solidaridad europea ante los principales retos y cooperación con Canadá
items.author: Jan Strupczewski, Yves Herman
items.creator: Jan Strupczewski, Yves Herman
items.summary: La presidenta de la Comisión Europea hará un llamamiento el miércoles a la solidaridad de la Unión Europea para hacer frente al cambio climático, la inteligencia artificial y la competencia de China, argumentando que ningún país de la UE puede afrontar estos retos por sí solo.
items.body:
La presidenta de la Comisión Europea hará un llamamiento el miércoles a la solidaridad de la Unión Europea para hacer frente al cambio climático, la inteligencia artificial y la competencia de China, argumentando que ningún país de la UE puede afrontar estos retos por sí solo.
En su discurso anual ante el Parlamento Europeo en Estrasburgo, la presidenta de la Comisión, Ursula von der Leyen, expondrá las prioridades de la UE, integrada por 27 países, para el próximo año.
Von der Leyen, que se encuentra ahora en su segundo mandato de cinco años al frente del órgano ejecutivo de la UE, hará hincapié en la necesidad de mantener la independencia europea en diversos sectores, entre ellos la energía, las materias primas y las tecnologías limpias, según han indicado fuentes oficiales.
Para lograrlo, los países de la UE no solo tendrán que trabajar juntos, sino también contar con socios sólidos como Canadá, cuyo primer ministro, Mark Carney, estará en Estrasburgo y pronunciará su propio discurso ante la Asamblea de la UE el jueves.
Es probable que Von der Leyen afirme que, aunque Canadá no pueda convertirse en miembro de la Unión Europea, la UE desea acercarlo lo más posible al bloque, ya que comparte los valores de Europa y podría ayudar a la UE a reducir su dependencia de China en materia de materias primas y su transformación, según han señalado fuentes oficiales.
Es probable que señale que estaba a favor de las negociaciones con China sobre cómo reducir el insostenible déficit comercial de la UE, que asciende a 1.000 millones de euros al día, pero que estas conversaciones debían dar resultados pronto. De lo contrario, la UE tendría que recurrir a otras medidas para proteger su economía.
Las fuentes oficiales indicaron que se espera que señale que la UE ya está sufriendo los efectos del cambio climático como ningún otro continente. El bloque deberá mantener su ambicioso rumbo en la mitigación del cambio climático, pero intensificar los esfuerzos para adaptarse a él, basándose en las experiencias de los últimos tres meses, cuando el continente se vio azotado por olas de calor e incendios sin precedentes.
Es probable que afirme que los líderes de la UE tendrán que hacer más para abordar las preocupaciones de los ciudadanos de que la inteligencia artificial supone una amenaza para el empleo y la ciberseguridad, y garantizar que la economía europea se beneficie de la IA.
Von der Leyen también abordará la migración hacia la UE y la necesidad de aprender de crisis como los sucesos de Ceuta a finales de julio, posiblemente mediante un refuerzo del papel de la agencia fronteriza de la UE, Frontex, según indicaron fuentes oficiales.
(1 € = 1,15 $)

items.title: ＳＫハイニックス、米で初の半導体メモリー製造へインテルと協議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Heekyong Yang　Alexandra Alper　Hyunjoo Jin

[ソウル／ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Heekyong Yang　Alexandra Alper　Hyunjoo Jin

[ソウル／ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 韓国ＳＫハイニックスは、同社として初めて米国で半導体メモリーを製造する取引について米インテルと協議を行っている。関係筋３人が明らかにした。

ＳＫハイニックスがオハイオ州にあるインテルがかねてから計画していた半導体製造施設の一部を賃借する可能性があるほか、インテルや大手クラウド企業と合弁会社を設立する可能性もあるという。

この合意が実現すれば、苦境に立たされているインテルへの圧力が軽減され、半導体メーカーに対し米国での生産を強く求めてきたトランプ政権にとっても大きな成果となる。

しかし、関係筋によると、先端メモリーの生産に関するいかなる合意も、これらの技術が機密性の高いものと見なされているため、韓国側からの潜在的な反対が大きな障害となる可能性がある。

同筋の１人は、今回の協議を「予備的なもの」と位置づけ、まだ決定は下されていないと強調。ＳＫハイニックスが取引の枠組みについて他の方法も検討している可能性があると付け加えた。

ロイターは、合意が成立した場合にＳＫハイニックスがオハイオ州でどのような種類のチップを製造する可能性があるかについては把握できなかった。

ＳＫハイニックスは、「メモリー事業の競争力を強化するため、追加の生産拠点の設立を含むさまざまな措置を検討している」としつつ、「現段階では何も決定されていない」と述べた。

インテルは、「憶測」についてはコメントを控えたが、オハイオ州の拠点を整備するための投資は継続していると付け加えた。

韓国産業通商省は、いかなる決定もＳＫハイニックスの裁量に委ねられるものの、「国家の中核技術」が関与する場合は産業技術保護法に基づく審査の対象となると述べた。

米商務省はコメント要請に応じなかった。

韓国産業通商省は、いかなる決定もＳＫハイニックスの裁量に委ねられるものの、「国家の中核技術」が関与する場合は産業技術保護法に基づく審査の対象となると述べた。

米商務省はコメント要請に応じなかった。

items.title: Real or not, Trump's helicopter money drop should alarm Warsh
items.author: Mike Dolan
items.creator: Mike Dolan
items.summary: A Federal Reserve rate hike will go down like a lead balloon at the White House. But the gap between President Donald Trump's wilder economic pronouncements and his new Fed chair is now so wide that the die may be cast.
items.body:
A Federal Reserve [USN:L6N45115A TEXT:"rate hike"] on Wednesday will go down like a lead balloon at the White House. But the gap between President Donald Trump's wilder economic pronouncements and his new Fed chair is now so wide that the die may be cast. Trump's promise of [USN:L4N44W0P3 TEXT:"$5,000 checks"] for every American probably offends Kevin Warsh's monetarist sensibilities most of all.
Most analysts in Washington and on Wall Street think Trump's pledge of a $5,000-per-person dividend if Republicans retake Congress this November is a non-starter.
There's [USN:L6N45211D TEXT:"no clear funding source"] for the total cost of at least $1.2 trillion, tariff revenue projections wouldn't come close to covering it, and the prospect of the U.S. Treasury adding to its debt mountain while struggling to control decades-high borrowing rates is downright alarming.
Even if Republicans surprised and retained both houses of Congress at the midterms, it's not clear that it would get the likely necessary approval. And as it stands, betting markets see more than a 50% chance of a Democratic sweep of both houses in seven weeks' time.
Far from backing away from it, however, Trump and his Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent continued to play up the political ploy this week.
"It's easy if the Republicans win," Trump said on Sunday, adding, "we can easily handle that because we're taking in so much money."
Bessent said on Tuesday that the administration would work with House Speaker Mike Johnson on the payments if a congressional green light was needed.
Yet even if it never happens, the proposal will alarm the Trump-appointed Warsh most of all. The very idea of helicoptering money to households in an economy with stubborn, above-target inflation, accelerating growth, a business investment boom, and a burgeoning government debt problem will rankle a central bank chair with clear monetarist leanings.
The Fed won't take the proposal into account in Wednesday's deliberations, concentrating on hard data rather than Trump's speculative promises.
But there's no doubt that if those checks ever saw the light of day, they would embolden the increasingly hawkish central bank to tighten policy and mop up what Warsh would — or at least should, given his frequently aired views — see as diesel on a smouldering inflation fire.
Warsh made clear in a number of interviews before arriving at the Fed that he saw the central bank's failure to act quickly enough to tamp down a government-funded explosion of the money supply around the pandemic lockdowns as "the greatest mistake in macroeconomic policy in 45 years".
DOES MONEY MATTER? Arguing in his annual [USN:L6N44S0R6 TEXT:"Jackson Hole speech"] last month that the money supply needed to be brought back onto the Fed's dashboard, Warsh reckons that had more attention been paid to money supply during the massive policy response to the COVID-19 pandemic, officials might better have spotted the huge spike in inflation that emerged.
Congress approved three separate direct payments in March 2020, December 2020, and March 2021 as part of sweeping relief packages to help people weather the pandemic. Those payments — up to $1,200, $600, and $1,400 per adult, respectively — were phased out for higher-income earners. That amounted to 476 million payments totaling $814 billion, according to a congressional oversight committee.
Annual growth in M2, a broad measure of money and bank deposits, hit a record 27% in early 2021, more than a year before the Fed started raising rates when inflation reached 7.2% by the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) measure it uses for its target.
After briefly contracting during a series of rate hikes that ended in 2023, M2's annual growth climbed back above 5% this year for the first time in four years — although it has ebbed slightly since July.
A one-off $1.2 trillion money drop down voters' chimneys, however, would amount to more than 5% of total M2 all on its own.
"Money matters," Warsh likes to say and repeated at Jackson Hole. "It's not fashionable these days, but my view is that money has something important to do with monetary policy."
He may want to communicate that to his president, given reports of regular calls between the two since Warsh took the chair.
At the very least, Trump is not making it easy for his appointee to build a case at the Fed for the sharply lower interest rates the White House routinely demands.
If Warsh votes for a Fed rate rise on Wednesday, he will be truer to his professional convictions than the president who gave him the job. But he may do well to turn off his social media feeds afterwards. Trump's tirades against Jerome Powell for not cutting rates fast enough were vicious — and Powell wasn't even pushing rates in the opposite direction.
Perhaps if the relationship breaks down this week, it'll be easier for the Fed chair to greet any eventual stimulus checks with the monetary policy speed he claimed the central bank lacked in 2021.
(The opinions expressed here are those of Mike Dolan , a columnist for Reuters.)

items.title: Super El Nino may blow Europe's gas demand forecasts off course
items.author: Gavin Maguire
items.creator: Gavin Maguire
items.summary: A record-strong El Nino weather pattern this winter bodes well for wind power generation potential across Europe, and could help limit the amount of gas required by utilities over Europe's peak heating demand period.
items.body:
A record-strong El Nino weather pattern this winter bodes well for wind power generation potential across Europe, and could help limit the amount of gas required by utilities over Europe's peak heating demand period.
Although El Nino is measured by sea temperatures in the central Pacific Ocean, its influence extends across much of the planet and can drive stronger winds and above-normal winter temperatures in Europe.
For European utilities, the potential combination of more sustained winds alongside warmer-than-usual weather through early 2027 means the region's natural gas needs may remain constrained this winter.
This could render moot [USN:L6N43Q0VZ TEXT:"worries about Europe's below-normal gas inventories"], and may dash hopes for a late-year swell in LNG imports by European traders.
SUPERSIZED EL NINO UNDERWAY El Nino is a periodic warming of sea surface temperatures in the Eastern Pacific caused by weakening trade winds. It occurs every two to seven years and tends to last up to 12 months, and can impact rainfall and temperature patterns in every region.
This year's El Nino "may be stronger than anything since our monitoring began. [USN:L6N44V0FF TEXT:"So literally off the charts"]," World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Secretary-General Celeste Saulo said at a Geneva press conference earlier this month.
Recent record-setting heat waves and droughts in Europe have already been linked to this year's El Nino, but the system may not be done impacting the region's weather patterns.
Indeed, the peak in El Nino readings is not expected to emerge until sometime between November and January, according to meteorological data service Nebbo, which means that Europe's winter weather trends will also be affected.
"El Nino winters tend to drive a negative pressure anomaly over the central North Atlantic. This steers the jet stream, channelling westerlies more directly into the UK, the North Sea, Ireland, and Scandinavia," Nebbo's Head of Technology, Gerard Castro, wrote in a recent report.
FAVOURABLE WINDS If these weather patterns unfold as expected, the wind farms off the North Sea and across Germany, the United Kingdom and France — home to a majority of Europe's total wind capacity — should see a sustained uptick in generation later in 2026.
This would be a welcome change from the sub-par wind output trends seen in recent years caused by prolonged spells of below-normal wind speeds at turbine level, which forced Europe's utilities to dial up generation from other sources.
These weak wind bouts were particularly evident in Germany, Europe's top wind power producer, where the term Dunkelflaute was coined to describe periods of dark doldrums when little solar or wind power was generated.
The peaks in German wind electricity production in 2024, 2025 and so far in 2026 came far below previous calendar year peaks due to a lack of sustained breezes in dense wind farm corridors.
And these wind generation shortfalls came despite steady increases to Germany's total wind farm capacity, which has climbed to a record of around 82 gigawatts as of mid-2026, according to Ember.
However, there are signs that Germany's wind generation trends are beginning to turn around, with output during August coming in more than 30% above the average for that month during the prior two years, according to generation data from LSEG.
Germany's wind farms generated around 390,189 megawatt hours of electricity per hour (MWh/h) in August, compared to around 298,000 MWh/h during August of last year and 277,075 MWh/h during August of 2024.
GAS SQUEEZE If wind speeds pick up as expected as autumn sets in, generation levels from Germany's wind farms should continue to press higher, resulting in system-wide repercussions for utilities.
Wind farms are the single largest source of electricity in Germany, accounting for around 28% of total utility-supplied electricity, according to Ember.
Coal is the next largest electricity source (around 20%), while natural gas is the third largest with a roughly 16% annual generation share.
At the system level, higher wind power generation tends to result in cuts to both coal and gas-fired production in Germany and across Northern Europe more broadly.
However, with benchmark European natural gas prices currently holding near their highest since late 2022, it is likely that utilities will attempt to pare their gas burn more quickly than coal during periods of high wind output.
Any prolonged stretches of reduced gas burns in Germany and elsewhere should limit any drawdowns in regional gas inventories, and may also limit buying interest for fresh gas supplies in the form of liquefied natural gas imports.
GETTING WARMER In addition to generating breezier conditions across Europe's largest wind belts, strong El Ninos have historically also resulted in milder average temperatures over the winter months.
Strong El Ninos have tended to favour what is known as a positive North Atlantic Oscillation, which is where high pressure brings in mild, wet air over mainland Europe.
And LSEG's weather forecasters are currently calling for those conditions to prevail into 2027.
"Temperatures are likely to be warmer across continental Europe and the Black Sea Region, with cold risks limited to Scandinavia and north/central Russia," LSEG weather analysts recently posted in an outlook for the 2026-27 winter.
Of course forecasts change, and the projections for a synchronous strengthening in El Nino measurements could peter out and yield a drier and colder winter than is currently expected.
But for now most major forecasters foresee a mild and breezy winter ahead for Europe, which could lift wind farm generation far above recent stunted levels and trigger sustained cuts to gas consumption across the region.

items.title: 金価格が反発、市場は原油小幅安とFOMCの利上げ観測を見極め
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 金相場は16日に反発。米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）がこの日利上げに踏み切ることがほぼ確実視される中、トレーダーは原油価格の小幅下落と利上げ観測をてんびんにかけている。

過去2日間下落していた金はこの日、一時1.1%高となり、1オンス＝4340ドルを上回った。原油は、供給混乱を背景とした上昇が行き過ぎたとの見方から下落し、インフレ懸念が幾分和らいだ。一方で、先週発表されたインフレ指標が予想を上回り、利上げ観測が強まったことを受け、市場は米利上げの確率を93%と織り込んでいる。借り入れコストの上昇は通常、利息を生まない金にとってマイナスとなる。

米10年国債利回りは約20年ぶりの高水準に上昇した後、低下した。世界的な債券売りは、活発な設備投資に加え、最近のエネルギー価格急騰がインフレを悪化させたことを背景に進んでいる。短期的な金融政策の影響を受けやすい米2年国債利回りも小幅に低下し、金への圧力が幾分和らいだ。

投資家はFOMCが2023年以来初めて利上げに踏み切ると予想している。利上げを見送った場合や、ウォーシュ米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）議長が追加利上げについて曖昧な姿勢を示した場合は、インフレが高止まりするリスクから投資資金を守るため、トレーダーが長期債に一段と高い利回りを求める可能性がある。

オーバーシー・チャイニーズ銀行（OCBC）のストラテジスト、クリストファー・ウォン氏は「市場は今週のFOMCでの利上げの可能性をすでに高く織り込んでおり、最大の不透明要因は利上げそのものより、その後に何が起きるかだ」と指摘。「米金融当局が追加引き締めの余地を残せば、金は一段と下落しやすくなる可能性がある」とし、4250ドルの重要な支持線を割り込めば4000ドルに向けた下落もあり得ると述べた。

シンガポール時間午後0時25分（日本時間同1時25分）時点で、金現物は0.8%高の1オンス＝4326.57ドル。銀は1.5%高の1オンス＝64.60ドル。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
米軍は15日、今年4月にイラン領内の奥深くで撃墜された米軍機の搭乗員を特殊部隊が救出したとする、高リスクの作戦の映像を公開した。
ロイターは映像の日付と場所を確認できなかった。ただ、米当局者はロイターに対し、米軍が4月5日に救出作戦を行い、イランで孤立していた米兵を安全な場所へ移送したと説明していた。
またトランプ米大統領も4月に、この作戦について明らかにするとともに、米国史上「最も大胆な」任務の一つだと述べていた。
救出された搭乗員は撃墜されたF-15戦闘機の兵器システム担当士官で、負傷したものの「問題はないだろう」とトランプ氏は4月に語っていた。

items.title: 米ロサンゼルスでＮＢＣヘリが墜落、3人死亡　事故現場取材中
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Bipasha Dey

[１５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Bipasha Dey

[１５日 ロイター] - ＮＢＣロサンゼルスは１５日、ロサンゼルスのチャッツワース地区で同局のニュースヘリコプターが同日夜に墜落し、３人が死亡、１人が負傷したと報じた。

ロサンゼルス消防局によると、墜落現場で確認された４人のうち、３人は死亡、１人は容体が不明のまま地元の病院へ搬送された。

ＮＢＣのキャスターは、墜落したヘリコプターに何人が搭乗していたかには言及しなかった。

消防局によると、国家運輸安全委員会（ＮＴＳＢ）と連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が墜落事故の調査を行うという。

ヘリコプターが墜落したチャッツワース地区ではこの日、バスと乗用車の衝突事故が起きていた。この衝突事故で少なくとも２人が死亡した。

複数のメディア報道によると、ＮＢＣのヘリコプターが墜落した際、衝突事故の取材のために数機の報道用ヘリコプターが現場付近に飛来していた。

米コムキャスト傘下のＮＢＣとロサンゼルス消防局は、詳細に関する問い合わせに直ちには応じていない。

イスラエル軍がガザで民間人の犠牲を容認しているとする映画「NAZA」が9月12日、第83回ベネチア国際映画祭の審査員特別賞を受賞した。24人のイスラエル情報機関員と兵士への匿名インタビューに基づく作品で、監督はイスラエルのユバル・アブラハム氏とレイチェル・ゾール氏。これについて同国のネタニヤフ首相は「我々は世界的な反ユダヤ主義と戦っているのに、同じイスラエル国民からそんな声が上がるなど到底容認できない」と述べた。

イスラエル軍がガザで民間人の犠牲を容認しているとする映画「NAZA」が、ベネチア国際映画祭の審査員特別賞を受賞した。

イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相
「話は聞いているが、非常にショックだ。
我々は世界的な反ユダヤ主義の煽動と戦っている。同じ国民からそんな声が上がるなど到底容認できない。
イスラエル国防軍（IDF）を戦争犯罪者として描く2人の監督が、ベネチア国際映画祭で喝采を浴びたという」

この映画は、作戦に関与した情報将校や兵士の証言を中心に構成されている。

イスラエルのユバル・アブラハム監督
「この映画を制作した理由の1つは、殺害システムを自ら実行し設計した将校や兵士らの証言を聞くことで、犯罪を否認することが難しくなると思うからだ。
沈黙や犯罪の否定は、問題の長期化に直結しているのだ。犯罪への沈黙や否定と、それが継続することの間には、直接的な相関関係が存在している」

レイチェル・ゾール監督
「付け加えておくべき重要な点として、こうした事実の多くはガザのパレスチナ人記者によりすでに記録され、広く知られているという点だ。
世に流出している映像ではあるが、証言を集めて映画に組み込むことには独自の意義があると実感した。
システムを設計し運用した当事者がカメラの前で直接語り、図で示しながら明らかにする声を聞くことは、これまでなかったからだ」

両監督は10日の上映時、25分間のスタンディングオベーションを受けた。

items.title: WTA roundup: Sloane Stephens squeezes into Guadalajara quarterfinals
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Sloane Stephens advanced to the quarterfinals of the Guadalajara Open by eking out a 7-6 (4), 7-6 (3) win over fifth-seeded Janice Tjen of Indonesia on Tuesday in Mexico.
items.body:
Sloane Stephens advanced to the quarterfinals of the Guadalajara Open by eking out a 7-6 (4), 7-6 (3) win over fifth-seeded Janice Tjen of Indonesia on Tuesday in Mexico.
After a first set that featured no service breaks, Tjen had two set points while serving at 5-2 in the second set. Stephens recovered to take that game, then broke serve again to level the set 5-5 before prevailing in another tiebreaker.
Stephens, the 2017 U.S. Open champion, won despite failing to save either of the break points on her serve and despite hitting just two aces to Tjen's 11.
Next up for Stephens will be an all-U.S. matchup against Peyton Stearns, who upset fourth-seeded Diane Parry of France 6-2, 7-5.
In the day's other second-round results, third-seeded Sara Bejlek of the Czech Republic eliminated Alycia Parks 6-4, 6-3, and sixth-seeded Cristina Bucsa of Spain downed Hungary's Panna Udvardy 6-4, 6-4.
SP Open
Ninth-seeded Darja Semenistaja of Latvia, who had lost her past nine main-draw matches, earned a first-round win in Sao Paulo, defeating Japan's Hayu Kinoshita 7-5, 6-4.
Semenistaja's skid included opening-round defeats at Wimbledon and the U.S. Open, each of which she reached as a lucky loser from qualifying.
Elsewhere at the rain-delayed tournament, Armenia's Elina Avanesyan beat Argentina's Julia Riera 6-2, 6-4; Serbia's Teodora Kostovic downed Brazil's Victoria Luiza Barros 6-2, 6-4; and Argentina's
Nadia Podoroska got past Italy's Lucrezia Stefanini 6-3, 6-4.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Marlins sink D-backs thanks to Esteury Ruiz's 3-run double in 11th
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Esteury Ruiz hit a tiebreaking three-run double with two outs in the 11th inning and the Miami Marlins outlasted the Arizona Diamondbacks 4-2 on Tuesday in Phoenix to prevent the D-backs from gaining ground in the National League wild-card race.
items.body:
Esteury Ruiz hit a tiebreaking three-run double with two outs in the 11th inning and the Miami Marlins outlasted the Arizona Diamondbacks 4-2 on Tuesday in Phoenix to prevent the D-backs from gaining ground in the National League wild-card race.
Taylor Clarke (2-4), the sixth Arizona pitcher, intentionally walked Kyle Stowers with one out in the 11th and walked Otto Lopez with two outs before Ruiz drove a ball to the wall in left-center.
Griffin Conine homered for the Marlins, who did not have an at-bat with a runner in scoring position until automatic runner Javier Sanoja was placed there to open the 10th in a 1-1 game.
Gabriel Moreno homered, singled, walked twice, stole a base and threw out two baserunners for the D-backs (80-72).
Ketel Marte had two doubles, and his two-out two-bagger in the 11th drove in Ildemaro Vargas to make it 4-2. Marte took third on a wild pitch before Moreno grounded out to end the game.
Josh Ekness (2-3), the eighth Miami pitcher, struck out two in two innings. The lone run he allowed was unearned.
The D-backs remained 2 1/2 games behind San Diego (82-69) in the NL wild-card chase, losing a chance to gain a game. The Chicago Cubs (84-68) and the Philadelphia Phillies (83-68) hold the top two wild-card positions. All four teams lost on Tuesday.
The Diamondbacks left two runners on base in both the ninth and 10th innings and stranded 15 overall. They finished 1-for-13 with runners in scoring position.
Arizona's Geraldo Perdomo was thrown out on a bang-bang play at home on a grounder attempting to score from third with one out in the 10th.
Marte has hit safely in 12 of 13 games since being activated from the injured list.
Arizona starter Michael Soroka gave up one run and two hits in five innings, leaving when his pitch count hit 80 in his second start back from the injured list. He struck out six and walked one.
Soroka struck out five in a row after Sanoja singled to open the second. Sanoja has reached in 15 straight games.
Miami starter Janson Junk gave up one run and five hits in three innings before the Marlins' bullpen took over. Junk struck out four and walked one.
--Field Level Media

items.title: China defence minister urges an end to 'provocative acts' to open security forum
items.author: Mei Mei Chu
items.creator: Mei Mei Chu
items.summary: Chinese Defence Minister Dong Jun urged nations on Wednesday to avoid provocative acts and curb the resurgence of regressive historical trends in remarks likely to be taken as veiled criticism of Japan.
items.body:
Chinese Defence Minister Dong Jun urged nations on Wednesday to avoid provocative acts and curb the resurgence of regressive historical trends in remarks likely to be taken as veiled criticism of Japan.
Dong's comments at the Beijing Xiangshan Forum on security come at a time of roiling regional tension over China-claimed Taiwan and the disputed South China Sea waterway, as doubt grows over traditional U.S. security commitments to Asia.
Warning that the world had arrived at a "fragile moment", Dong called for a fresher, more equal approach to resolving international tension, but offered few specifics or direct criticism of rivals.
"We must bear in mind the lessons of history and remain highly vigilant against all latent manifestations of hegemony, militarism and historical revisionism," he said in an opening speech.
"We must not turn a blind eye or condone such behaviour. By rallying broad-based forces of justice, we must suppress the resurgence of historical dregs and prevent them from exploiting the situation to cause harm."
Ties between China and Japan plummeted last year after Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested a hypothetical Chinese attack on Taiwan could trigger a Japanese military response.
That spurred Beijing to [USN:L4N3UA06H TEXT:"repeatedly warn"] that Japan was seeking a return to its militarist past, which included the Japanese occupation of northeast China's Manchuria in 1931 before a full war between the then-Republic of China and Japan.
Some 2,000 military officers, diplomats and academics from 100 countries are attending the three-day event set to run until Thursday, with delegates including some regional defence ministers, a senior Pentagon official, Russian academics and Taliban representatives.
NO DIRECT CRITICISM OF U.S. OR REGIONAL ALLIES As some analysts predicted, Dong steered clear of direct criticism of the United States or its regional allies, such as Japan, and appeared to hew closely to long-held Chinese positions.
Dong urged efforts towards a peaceful, multipolar world marked by "partnership rather than alliance, win-win rather than zero sum".
"We must show no leniency towards provocative acts that seek to hijack the overall interests of countries in the region for the sake of personal gain or the interests of particular cliques, and we must work together to rein them in," he added.
The comments come a week before Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to visit the United States for a summit with President Donald Trump .
China views democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory and has ramped up military pressure around the island, including periodically staging war games. Taiwan's government rejects Beijing's claims of sovereignty.
A tightly scripted rival to the more prominent Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore, which is widely seen as a more freewheeling affair, the forum comes at a time of China's expansion of military diplomacy. This often takes the form of [USN:L1N44809M TEXT:"bilateral exercises"] that military attaches say are slowly growing in complexity.
One of the sharper exchanges took place when a Saudi Arabian think-tank researcher, Prince Turki Al-Faisal, shared a panel with a senior Iranian military officer, Mohammad Taghi Osanlou.
Osaulou said the U.S. was attempting to maintain its "unipolar hegmonic system" against the tide of history, and external forces were tearing apart Middle Eastern unity.
While also criticising the U.S. and Germany, Al-Faisal said Saudi Arabia's immediate concern was Iran's inability to respect the sovereignty of the Arab states "culminating in its aggressive and unlawful attacks on their territories and assets in the recent war."

items.title: タイ、トランプ氏との首脳会談提案　貿易交渉妥結目指す＝商務相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [バンコク １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - タイのスパジー商務相は１５日、国連総会に出席するためニューヨークを訪れるアヌティン首相とトランプ米大統領による会談を提案したと明らかにした。両国は２国間貿易協定交渉の妥結と、関税率を巡る協議を模索している。

スパジー氏は記者団に、１７日か１８日にトランプ氏との会談を提案し、実現を見込んでいると述べた。

また、タイ商務省は首脳会談前に貿易交渉をまとめ、関税率や最終的な調整事項を首脳レベルの協議に委ねることを目指していると説明した。

タイは域内の競合国と同等の関税率による貿易条件を確保できると見込んでいるという。

米国は７月、タイからの輸入品に１２．５％の関税を課した。

米国はタイにとって最大の輸出市場で、年初からの全輸出の２４％を占めている。

items.title: Verdict attendu dans le procès pour crimes de guerre de l'ancien président du Kosovo
items.author: Stephanie van den Berg, Fatos Bytyci
items.creator: Stephanie van den Berg, Fatos Bytyci
items.summary: Le tribunal spécial chargé des crimes de guerre commis au Kosovo rendra mercredi son verdict dans l'affaire concernant Hashim Thaçi, ancien président du Kosovo, et plusieurs commandants de l'époque, accusés de meurtres et de tortures commis lors de l'insurrection de 1998-1999 ayant abouti à l'indépendance du pays.
items.body:
Le tribunal spécial chargé des crimes de guerre commis au Kosovo rendra mercredi son verdict dans l'affaire concernant Hashim Thaçi, ancien président du Kosovo, et plusieurs commandants de l'époque, accusés de meurtres et de tortures commis lors de l'insurrection de 1998-1999 ayant abouti à l'indépendance du pays.
Des peines de 45 ans de prison ont été requises à l'encontre de Hashim Thaçi et trois autres prévenus, tous anciens membres de haut rang de l'Armée de libération du Kosovo (KLA) avant de devenir politiciens. Tous nient les charges retenues contre eux.
Ce verdict sera suivi de près au Kosovo et en Serbie, où l'héritage du conflit et la déclaration d'indépendance du Kosovo en 2008 restent une source de tensions entre les Albanais du Kosovo et les Serbes.
Hashim Thaci est toujours considéré comme un héros par de nombreux Albanais du Kosovo. Dans de nombreuses villes du pays, des écrans géants ont été installés pour afficher le compte à rebours jusqu'au verdict, et des drapeaux de la KLA ont été hissés dans les rues principales.
La police a indiqué que des dispositions avaient été prises avec les forces internationales de maintien de la paix au cas où les manifestations deviendraient violentes. Les Etats-Unis et plusieurs autres ambassades ont conseillé à leurs ressortissants d'éviter les rassemblements.
Les procureurs de La Haye ont déclaré que plus de 100 opposants politiques et personnes soupçonnées de collaborer avec les forces de sécurité serbes avaient été tués par les forces de la KLA pendant le conflit.
Les avocats de Hashim Thaci ont fait valoir que ces accusations étaient sans fondement, estimant qu'elles n'étaient qu'une tentative de réécrire l'histoire.
Ils ont également affirmé qu'il n'existait aucune preuve permettant de lier directement l'ancien président à l'un des crimes présumés ni de conclure qu'il contrôlait d'autres commandants de la KLA.
Les chambres spécialisées pour le Kosovo et le Bureau du procureur spécial ont été créés en 2015 après la dissolution du Tribunal pénal international pour l'ex-Yougoslavie. Financées par l'Union européenne, elles relèvent du droit kosovar mais sont composées de magistrats internationaux.

items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領はAI開発にブレーキをかけるよう呼びかけるアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（CEO）を激しく批判しているものの、AI分野で中国が米国に追いつくのを阻止する必要があるという点では一致している。だが、実際に中国の追い上げを食い止めるのは容易ではない。

アモデイ氏は、「We Must Pace the Frontier」と題した3800語の論考で、先端AI向け半導体を中国に販売しないことや半導体密輸の取り締まり強化、「権威主義国家の企業による無許可の蒸留」の阻止などを当局者に求めた。民主主義国は「可能な限り大きな」リードを維持すべきだとも訴え、バイデン前政権と同様の表現を使った。

トランプ氏は最先端の半導体や製造装置に対する輸出規制を維持する一方、エヌビディアの「H200」などの半導体を中国に販売することには前向きな姿勢も示している。中国政府は自国産業の育成を図るため、H200の使用を避けてきた。

トランプ政権はこれまで、東南アジアでの半導体密輸を取り締まる厳しい措置には踏み込んでいないほか、米国のAIシステムを使って組織的に蒸留を行ったことが判明した中国企業への制裁や事実上の禁輸措置「エンティティーリスト」指定にも慎重な姿勢を取っている。

米国にとって最大の課題は、中国の追い上げを抑えつつ、精密誘導ミサイルやドローンなどのハイテク製品に使われるレアアースについて、中国政府による輸出規制のさらなる強化を招かないことだ。トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席は昨年、関税引き下げと引き換えに中国がレアアースの供給を保証することで休戦に合意した。この合意は、習氏が来週ホワイトハウスを訪問する際に延長される可能性が高い。

ブルッキングズ研究所ジョン・L・ソーントン中国センターでフェローを務めるカイル・チャン氏は、「中国政府がレアアースの輸出規制など、より強力な報復手段を持つようになった今、米政府は慎重に行動しなければならない」と指摘。「また、米国のAIブームを支えるデータセンターは、多くの部品を中国に依存している」とも語る。

items.title: Von der Leyen va appeler à la solidarité européenne et à un resserrement des liens avec le Canada
items.author: Jan Strupczewski, Yves Herman
items.creator: Jan Strupczewski, Yves Herman
items.summary: La présidente de la Commission européenne appellera mercredi à la solidarité au sein de l'Union européenne (UE) pour faire face aux défis que posent le changement climatique, l'intelligence artificielle et la concurrence de la Chine, en soulignant qu'aucun pays de l'UE ne peut les relever seul.
items.body:
La présidente de la Commission européenne appellera mercredi à la solidarité au sein de l'Union européenne (UE) pour faire face aux défis que posent le changement climatique, l'intelligence artificielle et la concurrence de la Chine, en soulignant qu'aucun pays de l'UE ne peut les relever seul.
Dans son discours annuel devant le Parlement européen, Ursula von der Leyen exposera les priorités de l'UE pour l'année à venir.
La présidente de la Commission européenne, qui entame actuellement son deuxième mandat de cinq ans à la tête de l'exécutif européen, insistera sur la nécessité de préserver l'indépendance de l'Europe dans divers secteurs, notamment ceux de l'énergie, des matières premières et des technologies propres, ont indiqué des responsables.
Pour y parvenir, les pays de l'UE devront non seulement travailler ensemble, mais aussi s'appuyer sur des partenaires solides comme le Canada, dont le Premier ministre, Mark Carney, sera présent à Strasbourg et où prononcera jeudi un discours devant le Parlement européen.
Ursula von der Leyen devrait souligner que, bien que le Canada ne puisse pas devenir membre de l'Union européenne, le bloc souhaite s'en rapprocher autant que possible, car il partage les valeurs de l'Europe et pourrait aider l'UE à réduire sa dépendance vis-à-vis de la Chine, notamment en ce qui concerne les matières premières et leur transformation, ont déclaré des responsables.
La présidente de la Commission européenne devrait rappeler qu'elle était favorable à des négociations avec la Chine sur les moyens de réduire le déficit commercial de l'UE, mais que ces discussions devaient aboutir rapidement, faute de quoi l'UE serait contrainte de recourir à d'autres mesures pour protéger son économie.
Ursula von der Leyen devrait également aborder les questions du changement climatique, de l'IA et de l'immigration, ont dit les responsables.
items.raw_description: La présidente de la Commission européenne appellera mercredi à la solidarité au sein de l'Union européenne (UE) pour faire face aux défis que posent le changement climatique, l'intelligence artificielle et la concurrence de la Chine, en soulignant qu'aucun pays de l'UE ne peut les relever seul.

items.title: Families desperate for news as 129 still missing four days after capsize of ship in Indonesia's Java Sea
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Desperation and frustration are growing among families of the 129 people still missing following the weekend capsizing of a ship in Indonesia's Java Sea, as persistent heavy seas and bad weather continue to restrict search-and-rescue operations.
items.body:
Desperation and frustration are growing among families of the 129 people still missing following the weekend [USN:L4N4570LZ TEXT:"capsizing"] of a ship in Indonesia's Java Sea, as persistent heavy seas and bad weather continue to restrict search-and-rescue operations.
The Virgo Transport 8 was carrying 243 people on a 20-hour voyage from Surabaya in East Java to Banjarmasin in South Kalimantan when it capsized in [USN:L4N45701Y TEXT:"bad weather"] early on Sunday.
On Wednesday, the official death toll stood at six people with 108 rescued and 129 unaccounted for, tallies that have not changed since Sunday.
"I hope we would use our advanced military equipment, we buy them to help people, right? Or else what for? For war? We likely will not go to war," said 37-year-old Fauzi, who has been waiting for news of seven family members, including his mother, who were on the [USN:L6N4560QZ TEXT:"ship"].
Fauzi, who goes by one name, said that after four days of waiting at the rescue command centre in Banjarmasin for promised updates about the search, his hopes have begun to fade.
"We do not hope much but what we need is certainty," he said.
The Coast Guard and Navy have been unable to launch underwater search-and-rescue operations because of waves of up to 2.5 metres (8.2 feet) and strong winds near the capsized vessel, I Putu Sudayana, the head of Banjarmasin's [USN:L6N45500M TEXT:"rescue"] agency, told Reuters.
On Wednesday, six ships were deployed for a surface search, Putu said, along with helicopters and aircraft.
Maria Dethan, 21, has stayed in the command centre since it was set up, anxiously waiting for news of her brother Samuel.
"Every time I am about to eat, I always remember my brother because I believe he has been starving for days," she told Reuters, saying she needed some certainty from authorities.
"I hope there will be clear information about my brother today," she said.

items.title: Dax fester erwartet - Fed-Entscheid im Fokus
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Am Mittwoch wird der Dax der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge mit Gewinnen starten. Am Dienstag hatte er etwas niedriger bei 25.402,28 Punkten geschlossen. Vor der Zinsentscheidung der US-Notenbank dürften sich die Anleger nicht allzu weit aus dem Fenster lehnen.
items.body:
Am Mittwoch wird der Dax (.GDAXI) der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge mit Gewinnen starten. Am Dienstag hatte er etwas niedriger bei 25.402,28 Punkten geschlossen. Vor der Zinsentscheidung der US-Notenbank dürften sich die Anleger nicht allzu weit aus dem Fenster lehnen.
Die Federal Reserve steuert aus Sicht der Finanzmärkte auf die erste Zinserhöhung seit über drei Jahren zu. Erwartet wird, dass der Leitzins um einen Viertelpunkt auf die Spanne von 3,75 bis 4,00 Prozent angehoben wird. "Die hohe Inflationsrate und die zugleich robuste US-Wirtschaft machen einen Zinsschritt wahrscheinlich. Sicher ist er aber nicht", sagt Portfoliomanager Thomas Altmann vom Vermögensverwalter QC Partners. Entscheidend für die Anleger wird Strategen zufolge sein, wie Fed-Chef Kevin Warsh die Inflationsrisiken bewertet und ob weitere Zinserhöhungen in Aussicht gestellt werden.
Der Fed-Entscheid wird um 20 Uhr MESZ erwartet.
Die Ölpreise geben nach der jüngsten Rally leicht nach.
In Asien notieren die Börsen moderat fester.
Am Nachmittag stehen die US-Einzelhandelsumsätze an.

items.title: Grab’s wild shopping spree takes a sensible turn
items.author: Katrina Hamlin
items.creator: Katrina Hamlin
items.summary: The Southeast Asian ride-hailing group's shares have plunged 40% this year despite buybacks as it snapped up a US investment app, a robot startup and more. Its latest $1.5 bln Atome deal pushes into consumer finance. Deferring part of the payment softens some of the blow.
items.body:
Grab's (GRAB.O) spending habits are worrying. The Southeast Asian ride-hailing group's Nasdaq-listed shares have plunged more than 40% this year despite buybacks as it snapped up a U.S. investment app, a robotics startup and more. But its latest acquisition underpins a strategic shift into consumer finance, as part of boss Anthony Tan's push to grow a fledgling finance business. A prudent deal structure should also soften some of the blow.
The $11.9 billion Singapore-based company will digest buy now, pay later outfit Atome in two tranches, starting with a 60% stake for $1.5 billion in cash. The remainder will follow two years later with the price based on the target's EBITDA and revenue performance. It's a clever way to protect shareholders from any downside while incentivising the target's management to hit growth targets. Atome's equity will be valued between $2 billion and $4.5 billion under this structure.
The bet is that Atome’s 25 million users and $1 billion gross loan portfolio can turbocharge Grab’s financial services division, which accounts for 13% of its top line. That should help offset slowing growth in the company’s core ride-hailing and food delivery business. Blame rising fuel prices, Indonesia's decision to cap commissions from two-wheeler drivers plus strikes in Vietnam. Rival GoTo's (GOTO.JK) Jakarta-listed shares fell 22% this year before they were frozen after hitting the stock market’s price floor.
The selloff makes for an awkward M&A spree. In January, Grab invested an undisclosed sum in Chinese robotics firm Infermove. In February it followed that up with a plan to acquire U.S. fintech whizz Stash Financial at a valuation of $425 million. A month later, it picked up Delivery Hero’s (DHER.DE) Taiwan business for $600 million.
At least Tan has a healthy war chest: as of June, the company’s net cash topped $5.4 billion. But Grab’s operating cash flow turned negative in the first half of the year. Moreover, it is in the midst of a massive share buyback scheme: on the same day it announced the Atome acquisition, it said it plans to complete the remaining $900 million over the next 12 months, bringing the total since 2024 to $1.75 billion.
So while Tan’s latest purchase looks sensible, it's hard to see the merits of Grab's broader M&A spree.
Follow @KatrinaHamlin on X
Singapore's Grab said on September 15 it would acquire buy now, pay later provider (BNPL) Atome Financial.
Grab will take an initial 60% stake in Singapore-based Atome for $1.49 billion, combining the target's BNPL loans, consumer cash loans, BNPL cards and digital lending with its own financial services business.
The company also agreed to acquire the remaining 40% stake about two years after the first transaction closes. That stake will be valued using a formula that applies a multiple of 13 times annualised, adjusted EBITDA and a 2.5 times multiple of annualised revenue, each measured based on the six-month period immediately prior to the second transaction closing and weighted at 75% and 25%, respectively.
The final equity valuation is subject to a $2 billion floor and a $4.5 billion ceiling.

items.title: Un drone houthi détruit au sud de La Mecque, dit la coalition menée par l'Arabie saoudite
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Les défenses aériennes de l'Arabie saoudite ont intercepté et détruit mardi un drone houthi au sud de La Mecque avant qu'il n'entre dans l'espace aérien, interdit, de la ville sainte, a dit un porte-parole de la coalition sous commandement saoudien qui combat les rebelles houthis au Yémen.
items.body:
Les défenses aériennes de l'Arabie saoudite ont intercepté et détruit mardi un drone houthi au sud de La Mecque avant qu'il n'entre dans l'espace aérien, interdit, de la ville sainte, a dit un porte-parole de la coalition sous commandement saoudien qui combat les rebelles houthis au Yémen.
La sécurité des deux sites les plus sacrés de l'islam et des pèlerins représente une "ligne rouge", a dit mercredi le porte-parole, ajoutant que la coalition prendrait les mesures de dissuasion nécessaires à l'encontre des Houthis.
Le Hadj, grand pèlerinage annuel effectué par des millions de musulmans, se déroule à La Mecque
L'Arabie saoudite a émis mardi des alertes de sécurité dans plusieurs zones du royaume, notamment à La Mecque et dans d'autres villes.
Les Houthis, qui contrôlent les zones les plus peuplées du Yémen et une grande partie du nord du pays dont la capitale Sanaa, ont lancé plusieurs attaques contre l'Arabie saoudite et en mer Rouge depuis leur annonce en juillet dernier d'un blocus maritime des ports saoudiens.
Une source militaire houthie a réfuté l'idée que le groupe présente une quelconque menace contre La Mecque et d'autres lieux saints, selon des propos rapportés mardi par l'agence de presse contrôlée par les Houthis, SABA.
Les Houthis, mouvement soutenu par l'Iran, ont pris le contrôle de plusieurs zones de la côte yéménite de la mer Rouge situés le long du détroit de Bab el-Mandeb, un des axes maritimes les plus stratégiques au monde.
Le groupe a annoncé plusieurs attaques d'importance contre l'Arabie saoudite la semaine dernière, dont des frappes contre une base aérienne lundi effectuées, selon lui, en représailles à des frappes menées au Yémen.

items.title: SK Hynix in talks with Intel about deal to make memory chips in the US for the first time, sources say
items.author: Heekyong Yang, Alexandra Alper, Hyunjoo Jin
items.creator: Heekyong Yang, Alexandra Alper, Hyunjoo Jin
items.summary: South Korea's SK Hynix is in talks with Intel about a deal that would see it manufacture memory chips on U.S. soil for the first time, three people familiar with the discussions said.
items.body:
South Korea's SK Hynix (000660.KS) is in talks with Intel (INTC.O) about a deal that would see it manufacture memory chips on U.S. soil for the first time, three people familiar with the discussions said.
Under one potential scenario, SK Hynix would lease part of Intel's long-planned chipmaking facility in Ohio, they said. Under another scenario, it could form a venture with Intel and major cloud firms that are keen to lock in memory chip supplies, two of the people said.
A deal would relieve pressure on Intel, which has been struggling, and mark a big win for the Trump administration, which has been ramping up pressure on chipmakers to build in the United States as relentless investment in AI and data centres fuels an acute shortage of memory chips.
But potential opposition from Seoul could be a major hurdle, the sources said.
One of the sources described the talks as exploratory and stressed that no decisions have been made, adding that SK Hynix might also consider other ways to structure the deal.
Details about how a SK Hynix-Intel deal might be structured are being reported for the first time. Reuters was, however, not able to learn what types of chips SK Hynix may manufacture in Ohio if an agreement is struck.
Its product lineup includes DRAM (dynamic random-access memory) chips used in servers, PCs and smartphones and NAND flash memory chips that provide long-term storage memory. It is also the leading supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) used in AI processing units.
POTENTIAL OPPOSITION FROM SEOUL Any agreement to produce advanced memory such as HBM or even DRAM could run into opposition from the South Korean government as those technologies are considered sensitive, said the three sources who declined to be identified as the information is not public.
SK Hynix said in a statement to Reuters that it is "reviewing various measures, including establishing additional production bases, to strengthen the competitiveness of its memory business," but "no matters have been determined at this stage."
Intel declined to comment on what it called speculation, but added that it was continuing with investments in Ohio to ready the site.
Asked about a potential SK Hynix plan to produce chips in the U.S., South Korea's trade ministry said any decision would be at the company's discretion but if it involved a "national core technology," it would be subject to a review under the Industrial Technology Protection Act.
The U.S. Commerce Department did not respond to a request for comment.
GOOD REASONS TO BUILD IN THE U.S. Manufacturing semiconductors in the U.S. costs much more than in South Korea, according to two of the sources. Building in the United States entails significantly higher labour and construction costs, and much of the semiconductor industry's supply chain is located within Asia, which also increases U.S. costs, one of them said.
Even so, SK Hynix, which recently completed a [USN:L1N43C098 TEXT:"secondary listing on the Nasdaq"] in July and currently only has a [USN:L1N44O0T4 TEXT:"chip packaging facility"] under construction in Indiana, has good reasons to pursue fabricating chips in the United States.
Chey Tae-won, chairman of the SK Group conglomerate that SK Hynix is part of, said in July that the company faces enormous pressure and lobbying from customers and countries to supply more chips.
"I think we need to build a factory in the United States. If possible, I believe we should build it," he told reporters.
A deal with SK Hynix would also ease some of the financial strain on Intel, which is part-owned by the U.S. government.
Intel [USN:L4N2U10WE TEXT:"announced in 2022"] that it would invest up to $100 billion to build potentially the world's largest chipmaking complex in Ohio, with production scheduled to begin in 2025. But completion of the site's two plants has since been [USN:L3N3PJ1DF TEXT:"delayed"] to 2030 and 2031.
Pleasing both Washington and Seoul could be tough, however, particularly as SK Hynix and rival Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) have been urged by the Seoul to accelerate plans to build a new cluster of chipmaking facilities in [USN:L4N4310DN TEXT:"South Korea's southwest"].
U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has threatened to impose up to 100% tariffs on South Korean and Taiwanese companies unless they commit to increased production on American soil.
Both countries have also been wrangling over the execution of a huge investment commitment that South Korea made to the U.S. last year in return for lower U.S. tariffs. Some $150 billion of a proposed $350 billion has been earmarked for shipbuilding but the remaining $200 billion is undecided.
Two of the sources said this has left SK Hynix in a difficult position, with the South Korean government seeking to use any U.S. investment by SK Hynix as leverage in the talks, and Washington heaping pressure on the firm to quickly commit to a U.S. expansion.

items.title: Dominant China wary of hosts Japan in Asiad table tennis competition
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's table tennis team are wary of the threat presented by hosts Japan at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games as the sport's superpower looks to bring on younger talent with an eye on the 2028 Olympics.
items.body:
China's table tennis team are wary of the threat presented by hosts Japan at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games as the sport's superpower looks to bring on younger talent with an eye on the 2028 Olympics.
Olympic champions Sun Yingsha, Wang Manyu and Wang Chuqin will lead China's campaign but the 10-strong team also includes seven players making their debut at the Asiad.
China have dominated table tennis at the Asian Games since their first appearance in 1974, sweeping all of the gold medals in 1978, 2010 and 2018.
The South Korean pairing of Jeon Ji-hee and Shin Yu-bin denied China the sweep with a women's doubles triumph in Hangzhou three years ago but women's head coach Ma Lin is more concerned about the threat of the host nation this year.
"We have analysed Japanese players' playing styles and know exactly what we are up against," Ma told Xinhua news agency as the team departed for Japan on Wednesday.
"We need to stay vigilant, treat every ball seriously and hold ourselves to strict standards in training."
The rivalry between China and Japan in the women's game has grown from extremely close team finals at the last two editions of the World Table Tennis Championships.
Sun led China to comeback wins in both and was only recently usurped as world number one by teammate Wang Manyu with Japanese teenager Miwa Harimoto ranked third.
"We are closely matched," said Sun, who won three gold medals in Hangzhou.
"It all goes down to on-court performance and team cohesion. That counts most."
Harimoto, born in Japan to Chinese parents, and partner Hina Hayata top the rankings in women's doubles, while South Koreans Shin and Lim Jong-hoon are number one in mixed doubles, but Ma was upbeat about China's chances of a title sweep.
"We will go all out to fight for every gold medal," the former men's world number one added.
"Huge challenges lie ahead, yet we have full confidence. Whatever obstacles come our way, we will fight to win."
The men's team are less experienced with defending singles champion and world number one Wang Chuqin the only one of the four players with previous Asian Games experience.
Japan's Sora Matsushima and Tomokazu Harimoto, Miwa's brother, are third and fourth in the men's singles rankings but China's head coach Qin Zhijian thought the mix of youth and experience would come up trumps.
"The three Olympic champions pass on their experience to the seven young players, while the younger ones bring passion and drive to inspire the Olympic medallists," he said.
Table tennis gets underway with the team competitions at the Sky Hall Toyota on Sunday.

items.title: China Defense Minister Urges Nations to Curb Regressive Historical Trends
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Mei Mei Chu Chinese Defense Minister Dong Jun urged nations on Wednesday to avoid provocative acts and curb the resurgence of regressive historical trends in remarks likely to be taken as veiled criticism of Japan. Dong’s comments at the Beijing Xiangshan Forum on security come …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Mei Mei Chu

Chinese Defense Minister Dong Jun urged nations on Wednesday to avoid provocative acts and curb the resurgence of regressive historical trends in remarks likely to be taken as veiled criticism of Japan.

Dong’s comments at the Beijing Xiangshan Forum on security come as regional tensions boil over over China-claimed Taiwan and the disputed South China Sea waterway, as doubt grows over traditional U.S. security commitments to Asia.

Warning that the world had arrived at a “fragile moment”, Dong called for a fresher, more equal approach to resolving international tension, but offered few specifics or direct criticism of rivals.

“We must bear in mind the lessons of history and remain highly vigilant against all latent manifestations of hegemony, militarism and historical revisionism,” he said in an opening speech.

“We must not turn a blind eye or condone such behavior. By rallying broad-based forces of justice, we must suppress the resurgence of historical dregs and prevent them from exploiting the situation to cause harm.”

No Direct Criticism of United States or Regional Allies

As some analysts predicted, Dong steered clear of direct criticisms of the United States or its regional allies, such as Japan, and appeared to hew closely to long-held Chinese positions.

“We must show no leniency towards provocative acts that seek to hijack the overall interests of countries in the region for the sake of personal gain or the interests of particular cliques, and we must work together to rein them in,” he added.

The comments come a week before Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to visit the United States for a summit with President  Donald Trump .

Ties between China and Japan plummeted last year after Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested a hypothetical Chinese attack on Taiwan could trigger a Japanese military response.

That spurred Beijing to repeatedly warn that Japan was seeking a return to its aggressive past.

China  views democratically governed  Taiwan  as its own territory and has ramped up military pressure around the island, including periodically staging war games. Taiwan’s government rejects Beijing’s claims of sovereignty.

Some 2,000 military officers, diplomats and academics from dozens of countries are attending the three-day event set to run until Thursday.

A tightly scripted rival to the Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore, which is widely seen as a more freewheeling affair, the forum comes at a time of China’s expansion of military diplomacy.

This often takes the form of  bilateral exercises  that military attachés say are slowly growing in complexity.

items.title: ブラジル大統領選、決選投票でルラ氏がボルソナロ氏下す見通し＝調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [サンパウロ １５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[サンパウロ １５日 ロイター] - ブラジル運輸連盟（ＣＮＴ）と調査会社ＭＤＡが１５日公表した世論調査によると、来月の大統領選で決選投票になった場合、ルラ大統領がボルソナロ前大統領の長男で右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員に勝利するという結果が示された。

・決選投票になる場合、ルラ氏の得票率は４７．３％、ボルソナロ氏は４０％となった。

・８月１１日の調査では、それぞれ４８％と３９．１％だった。

・第１回投票のシナリオでは、ルラ氏が４０．５％で首位、次いでボルソナロ氏が３０．４％、アウグスト・クリ氏が６％、ロナウド・カイアド氏が３％、レナン・サントス氏が２．７％となった。

・第１回投票の前回調査では、ルラ氏が４２．４％、ボルソナロ氏が２８．７％だった。

・１０月４日の第１回投票でいずれの候補も有効票の５０％超を獲得できなければ、上位２候補が１０月２５日の決選投票に進む。

・ＣＮＴは９─１３日に２００２人を対象に調査を実施。誤差はプラスマイナス２．２％ポイント。

items.title: ゼロ金利時代の日本国債やドイツ国債は「宝物」－アジムットが逆張り
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 投資家が長期債を売り込む状況で、逆張り戦略を採用し、最も値下がりした銘柄を積極的に物色するファンドマネジャーが存在する。

資産運用会社アジムット・グループの債券グローバル共同責任者ニコロ・ボッキン氏は、数十年先まで償還期限が到来せず、ほとんど、あるいは全く利払いが行われない債券におおむね特化したニッチファンド、「AZボンド・バリュー・ファンド」（ルクセンブルクで登録）を運用している。

金融危機が最も深刻だった時期から新型コロナ禍終息に至るゼロ金利時代に発行された債券が投資対象だ。年利わずか0.5%の日本国債、表面利率0%の利付国債として発行された2050年満期のドイツ国債などが挙げられる。

日米など各国政府は、あらゆる借り入れの指標となる長期国債への売り圧力にさらされ、短期債の発行にシフトしている。額面を著しく下回る「ディストレスト状態」で取引されるゼロ金利時代の遺物とも言える債券が、バーゲンハンター（安値拾いの投資家）にとって宝物になる可能性があるとボッキン氏は指摘した。

これらの債券は大部分が額面の半値前後で取引される。コロナ禍後の積極的な利上げ、その後の長期利回り上昇で打撃を受けたこの種の債券価格は、インフレ懸念や財政不安に起因する最近の債券下落局面で、価格が一段安となった。

ドバイを拠点とするボッキン氏にとって、それは好機だ。 「こうした長期債を仕入れることが可能で、しかも非常に安い価格で支払いが済む良い環境だ」と同氏は歓迎する。

アジムット（運用資産1580億ユーロ＝約28兆3000億円）が逆張り戦略の一環として行う投資は、かなりのリターンが期待できる。しかし利回りが上昇している以上、相応の大きな市場リスクも存在する。

長い満期と低い表面利率、割安な価格の組み合わせがファンドのセールスポイントだが、保有資産は金利全般の変化に比較的敏感だ。「デュレーション（投資の平均回収期間」が比較的長いため、利回りが低下すれば価格は一段と値上がりする。しかし逆もまた真だ。打撃を和らげるクーポンの支払いがない状況で、今は保有資産の価値が急落している。

items.title: Ukraine-Une nouvelle arme anti-drones à l'essai, dit Zelensky
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'Ukraine teste actuellement une nouvelle arme développée afin d'intercepter des drones, a déclaré mardi le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, indiquant que des essais avaient été réalisés avec succès la nuit dernière.
items.body:
L'Ukraine teste actuellement une nouvelle arme développée afin d'intercepter des drones, a déclaré mardi le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, indiquant que des essais avaient été réalisés avec succès la nuit dernière.
"Une nouvelle arme est actuellement à l'essai. Elle a été développée par l'Ukraine et a enregistré un succès: un (drone) Shahed a été détruit la nuit dernière", a dit Volodimir Zelensky lors de son allocution quotidienne.
"Certaines choses doivent encore être réglées au niveau technique. Nous avons besoin d'un peu de temps."
L'armée ukrainienne a dit sur Facebook que 187 drones avaient été abattus dans la nuit de lundi à mardi.
Volodimir Zelensky a dit mardi soir que 93% des drones lancés par la Russie la nuit précédente avaient été interceptés.
